layout.mobileHeader: Opaque sticky header at top: 0, z-index 30. Content height 78px, 76px at 650px and below, plus --safe-area-top. Side padding respects landscape safe areas.
layout.mobileNavigation: Fixed bottom navigation at z-index 40. Border-box ResizeObserver publishes --mobile-nav-height, including safe-area padding, and removes it on unmount. Active destinations use soft fill, text color, 8px corners and 600 weight; each link has a 44px minimum width.
layout.bottomClearance: At 900px and below, shell padding-bottom and toast offset are measured navigation height + 16px; update banner offset equals navigation height. Desktop reserves no navigation space.
layout.forms: minmax(0, 1fr) grid tracks, min-width: 0 fields, and controls constrained to available width. Shared submit and optional Cancel actions wrap together. Checkboxes have 44px label targets. Errors retain edits and receive focus; busy forms disable controls and guard duplicate submission.
layout.settingsNavigation: Local rail above 1100px; labeled selector at 1100px and below. Hidden sections stay mounted to preserve unsaved fields.
layout.navigationScroll: New history entries start at the top. POP restores per-entry coordinates; new fragment destinations scroll to and focus the target. Resize/mutation observation waits up to ten seconds for content, with cancellation on user input. Account-scoped tab session storage retains at most 100 entries across reloads; clearing personal data removes it.
layout.dialogs: Native modal follows the visual viewport with 20px gaps, reduced to 12px at widths up to 650px or heights up to 500px. The heading stays fixed above one scrollable body; the page behind cannot scroll. Touch fields use at least 16px type. Dismissal protects unsaved edits and restores opener focus.
layout.pageHeadings: Page headings and actions wrap with a 280px text basis. List detail headings stack title and actions without a fixed text height. Long names and labels wrap within their columns.
layout.privateGiftIdeas: Active wish lists offer Add gift idea to givers. Ideas belong to a person; joint lists require an explicit recipient. The form places Who can see this idea? before product entry and defaults to Only me. Private cards, detail pages, and Buying entries show a lock with Only me. Saved idea links use /people/:id?tab=ideas to preserve the selected tab.
layout.paragraphRhythm: Metadata uses 4px; headings and related explanations 8px; ordinary prose 12px; controls 16px; sections 32px, reduced to 24px at 650px. Text stacks own spacing and reset child margins. Form groups use 16px; adjacent explanations use 8px. Intentional hero and card compositions retain their own spacing.
layout.profileEditor: Person pages and Settings open one Edit profile dialog with Profile and Gift preferences tabs. Both drafts stay mounted. Saves are independent and keep the dialog open. Done and Close protect dirty forms in either tab; successful saves clear their confirmation state. Quiet underlined Gift preferences text actions appear in Settings and owned/managed person pages. In Settings the shortcut sits below account details, leaving the outlined Edit profile button as the main action. Interest choices use one column at widths up to 360px.
layout.giftDetails: Recipient, title, status, price and quantity use a 12px stack. The phone image gap is 16px, and the back-link gap is 8px. Reservation and detail-section headings match at 22px desktop and 21px phone; explanations use 14px/1.5 with a 65ch maximum. Buying for belongs with reservation controls before quantity, bounded to 32rem, with an exchange-versus-separate-gift explanation. Archived and recipient views retain context access beside gift actions.
layout.administration: Paper panels use 12px corners, 20px padding, 16px phone padding, and 24px separation. Panel headings use 20px and internal headings 17px. Group creation, automatic product photos, device photo caching and prefetching are editable, with optional ENV locks. Preference groups have a divider with 24px on either side. Service and job rows have top dividers, 16px padding, and no trailing rule or bottom padding on the last row. Service status aligns at the top and stacks below descriptions at 360px. Photo explanations use 8px gaps. Monthly usage uses flat groups with 16px top and 8px bottom padding, 44px disclosure targets, 13px labels, and 18px counts. Final paragraphs do not add trailing space. App settings use independent family-group and product-photo saves with inline status and Discard changes. Photo rows have 16px gaps, 8px label/help spacing, and preloading indented 24px beneath caching. Scope appears once above the groups. Unchanged saves are disabled.
layout.groupActions: Follow sits outside group navigation with a 32px horizontal gap and wraps independently on narrow screens.
layout.invitationSharing: Post-create confirmation and pending invitation rows use outlined sign-in-link actions. Native sharing falls back to copying; failures expose a selectable read-only link. The invitation-share container uses a 12px grid gap with wrapping actions.
layout.productImages: Preserve photo dimensions and object-fit contain. Load visible thumbnails promptly. Retain the thumbnail until the detail photo decodes. Administration offers separate default-on cache and prefetch controls with environment locks. Preloading appears unchecked and disabled while caching is off, retaining its saved preference for restoration when caching returns. Photo settings save atomically. Real-photo frames use theme paper and 10px padding. Warm tag-derived variations belong only to missing-photo placeholders.

management.sorting: Search stays beside Sort & filter, wrapping on the narrowest screens. Mixed-recipient gift views offer a People checkbox disclosure; person pages omit it. Selections match any recipient and combine with search, tag and availability. Empty selection means everyone. People counts as one active filter, and selected names remain summarized. Per-history-entry filter state restores through reload and browser navigation. Clear filters preserves search and saved sorting.
management.priority: Optional Most wanted, Would love, and Nice to have labels. No implied numeric rank; labels remain attached when sorting changes.
management.actions: List, event, exchange and purchase menus have visible action labels; gift-card overflow controls have accessible names. All controls retain 44px targets. Menus stay within viewport edges and close on Escape or focus departure. Confirmation dialogs offer Cancel; reorder dialogs support drag handles and move-up/down buttons with Save and Cancel.
management.lifecycle: Active, Archived, and Trash views are distinct. Group events preserve participant lists on removal. Permanent deletion requires an explicit second confirmation.
management.footer: Everyday pages have no attribution footer or bottom divider. Settings → About contains the approved logo, tagline, version, and readable Created by Affolder Creative credit. The loading screen carries a quieter credit outside the loading status announcement and above mobile safe areas. About includes Kyle’s approved family-origin story at 15px within 62ch and a theme-aware SVG sign-off traced from Kyle’s selected screenshot with a matching dash, 76px wide at its original proportions.

privacyDisclosure.presentation: Native nonmodal popover, closed initially even for scheduled summaries. Click/tap or keyboard activation; Close, Escape and outside-click dismissal. No page reflow.

draftRows.states: Green check for Ready to review; accent help for Needs details; fixed-width working dots while fetching. Status meaning never relies on color alone.
draftRows.autosave: Saved feedback lasts three seconds in a reserved 18px slot beneath Save for later, preserving action alignment.

maintenancePatterns.jobFailures: Collapsed categories with counts, queued timestamps and ten-row increments.
maintenancePatterns.phoneManagement: Separate primary save from number actions and inline removal confirmation.
maintenancePatterns.eventCollections: Keep event lists beside their event. With editable event lists in the selected status, label the lower section Other wish lists and use a short empty note. Manage event moves into Event actions; participant-list links remain visible.
maintenancePatterns.backgroundJobs: Separate Price checks and Updates and shop lookups groups; 15px headings, 12px fact labels and 14px tabular values. Facts use two columns with 12px by 24px gaps and stack on narrow phones. Provider usage stays in a disclosure.
maintenancePatterns.accountClosure: Resolve these first leads subordinate 14px blocker headings, compact copy and 24px task gaps. No row dividers. Destination-specific secondary links identify the next step.

contextualHelp.panel: 13px text, 12px padding, 12px corners, theme paper and control border; max 20rem width with 12px viewport insets. Accessible title is visually hidden.
contextualHelp.placement: Native nonmodal popover, above when space allows, below otherwise. Reposition on scrolling and viewport changes.
contextualHelp.dismissal: Close button, Escape, or outside click; restore trigger focus.

reservationConfirmation.action: Underlined Open Buying link, 44px minimum target, navigates to /buying and dismisses confirmation.
reservationConfirmation.timing: Ten seconds; hover or keyboard focus suspends dismissal. Leaving restarts the interval. Other messages default to five seconds.

maintenancePatterns.gridFilters: Available gifts by default; typed search includes taken-care-of gifts. Own surprise lists preserve purchase privacy. Explicit Wish/Gift idea labels and type filter; People uses a searchable multi-select.

spendingAssignments.mobileGiftSuggestions: One-line title with ellipsis at 650px; supporting text wraps.
spendingAssignments.actionMenus: Visible viewport collision placement above fixed navigation; flip upward or scroll internally.
spendingAssignments.wishListOptions: Native optgroups by owner or combined owners; preserve historical options.

narrative.northStar: A little thought. A lovely surprise.
narrative.overview:
**Creative North Star: "A little thought. A lovely surprise."**

Little Hint is a calm place to coordinate gifts for people you know. Recipient names, gift details, prices, and availability lead. Warm paper backgrounds, quiet dividers, and open rows give those details room.

The approved heart-tag artwork carries the brand. Its outlined Fraunces lettering remains an image asset; the interface uses the established system sans stack. Light and dark themes share the same hierarchy and shapes.

**Key Characteristics:**

- Approved heart-tag artwork and outlined lettering.
- Ivory and umber neutrals with sienna actions and blush selection fills.
- Flat gift cards with recipient details directly below the image.
- Desktop sidebar and mobile bottom navigation.
keyCharacteristics: Approved heart-tag artwork and outlined lettering.
Ivory and umber neutrals with sienna actions and blush selection fills.
Flat gift cards with recipient details directly below the image.
Desktop sidebar and mobile bottom navigation.

rules.name: The semantic color rule
rules.body: Use the theme variables for interface text, controls, and backgrounds so light and dark modes preserve their roles.

rules.name: The artwork rule
rules.body: Use the supplied logo and symbol assets. Do not recreate their lettering with live text.

rules.name: The flat content rule
rules.body: Gift cards and ordinary list rows have no shadow. Reserve elevation for dialogs and transient messages.

rules.name: Available notification channels
rules.body: Omit deployment-unavailable SMS and Telegram controls and summaries without placeholders. Preserve hidden choices when saving visible settings. Keep administrator configuration diagnostics visible.

rules.name: Master AI availability
rules.body: When AI_ENABLED is false, omit discovery entry points, AI service rows, AI usage sections, and AI-specific report copy. Preserve stored history and saved gifts. Other service diagnostics and usage remain independent. Direct discovery links show a generic unavailable page.

rules.name: Connection fallback
rules.body: Connection screens use approved horizontal artwork, the existing headline and body typography, and the current light or dark palette. Center a narrow text group with generous space after the logo, then a primary retry action. Supporting text uses the muted foreground. Personal draft controls follow as a separate, quieter group. Center the standalone clear-device action beneath this group. Preserve mobile safe-area padding, visible focus, and a stable layout during retries. A playful headline may introduce the problem; the explanation and recovery action stay plain.

rules.name: Administration service status
rules.body: Administration contains App settings, This month's usage, Service status, and Background jobs. Family-group creation, automatic product photos, device photo caching, and photo prefetching are editable, with optional locking ENV overrides. All service credentials, providers, models, limits, and AI availability are deployment-only. Service status reports configuration presence, not verified connectivity. When AI_ENABLED is false, omit AI service rows, AI usage groups, and AI-specific explanatory copy even when history exists. Retain other disabled services’ current-month usage with Currently off; omit sections with only prior-month or skipped SMS history. Preserve notification retries, failed shop lookups, and the note that backup status is unavailable.

dos: Do use the approved horizontal or tagline artwork and its dark variant where the component supports it.
Do keep recipient, gift title, price, and visible availability together.
Do contain product images and show the labeled placeholder when an image is missing or fails.
Do keep active availability and other filters visible in the results summary when the filter dialog is closed.
Do retain visible keyboard focus, named icon controls, reduced-motion behavior, and mobile safe-area padding.
donts: Don't reconstruct the logo lettering or substitute a display font for the approved artwork.
Don't add shadows to ordinary gift cards or list rows.
Don't use invented product photography or present demonstration fixtures as real gifts.
Don't rely on color alone to explain availability or list privacy.
